title: How Pringles maker Kellanova is using AI and a partnership with Siemens to improve production of the chip in Europe, including making digital twins of its dough (Isabelle Bousquette/Wall Street Journal)
summary: Isabelle Bousquette / Wall Street Journal: How Pringles maker Kellanova is using AI and a partnership with Siemens to improve production of the chip in Europe, including making digital twins of its dough — Kellanova, which manufactures Pringles in Europe, says a new AI project could be the key to improving production of the iconic chip
